description:
NinjaTrader 8 is open on the Windows desktop with real daily OHLCV data available for AAPL and MSFT (Jan 2023 - Dec 2024).

A sector analyst needs to compare the price action of AAPL (Apple) against MSFT (Microsoft) on the same timeline.

Your task:
1. Open a new Chart for 'AAPL' with 'Daily' bars.
2. Add 'MSFT' with 'Daily' bars as a secondary Data Series to the same chart. (Right-click chart > Data Series).
3. Add an 'EMA' (Exponential Moving Average) indicator to the chart.
4. CRITICAL: Configure the EMA to use 'MSFT' as the Input Series (change Input Series from 'Default' to 'MSFT').
5. Set the EMA Period to 20.
6. Click OK. You should see AAPL candles in the top panel, and MSFT candles with an EMA line in the bottom panel.
7. Save the workspace via File > Save Workspace.
